notes: The delivery service's service manifest (kind delivery): DL-1 to DL-5 of 12.1 after services.md S-1 to S-8. Built on its own copy of the base world; step-10 failures and the version 2 cases were appended by a misbehaving log so a phone reaches the rule. DL-4 bounds limits.tokensPerIssuance (64) and limits.commitsPerHour (3,600). Keys that do not belong to a delivery manifest are refused at step 4 by services.md S-1, S-3 and S-7, which the two S-* cases here show.
